title: cleanup_tmp_files before cleanup_orphan_msg_files ordering is load-bearing
description: start_drain() runs cleanup_tmp_files() before cleanup_orphan_msg_files(). This ordering is correct: if a .msg.tmp existed and was NOT renamed to .msg before the crash, it must be deleted (not quarantined). If cleanup_orphan ran first, it would only see .msg files; the .msg.tmp files would be processed anyway in cleanup_tmp. But the concern is subtler: cleanup_orphan checks for the existence of a .env peer for each .msg. If .msg.tmp were misidentified as .msg (which it cannot be because cleanup_orphan filters by .ends_with('.msg') not '.msg.tmp'), it could be mistakenly quarantined. The current order (tmp cleanup first) ensures the queue dir is clean of tmp files before orphan detection runs, making orphan detection deterministic. A future contributor might reorder these calls. They must not.
